label: wave
definition: A parallel batch inside a sprint: the issues that can run at once, with no open blocker among them, file-disjoint, within the session budget. cckit effort plan --issues lays the open work into waves by its blocked_by edges; cckit orchestrate runs one wave in parallel worktrees; cckit watch merges it and advances to the next. A sprint usually runs several waves.
is_not: An effort: an effort is one goal; a wave is a layer of the dependency graph and may hold issues from several efforts.
A sprint: a sprint is one week, Monday to Monday, with a goal; a wave lives inside it and ends when its PRs merge.
The whole plan: the plan is the ordered list of waves.
avoid: round (a round is one agent pass inside autopilot run)
